about: Sarah MacLeod attended law school and graduated from University of Washington School of Law in 2005. Sarah MacLeod began practicing law in 2006.
Sarah MacLeod is an attorney at Everbridge Law Group, helping people with Estate Planning & Probate issues. Everbridge Law Group has an office in Seattle, Washington, serving the local community.

Sarah MacLeod was selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
